text: And before we dive into Gmail, I'd love to give you a little background on what we do.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: We're an agentic document platform, which basically means we help teams turn messy, unstructured documents into data that AI can actually use accurately.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: To give you some context, in the last three years, we've raised $108 million from investors like ACCNC, Benchmark, and more, and processed over two billion documents across customers like Harvey, Scale, and a top five global hedge fund.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: And operating at that scale means that we've basically dealt with every document you can possibly think of, and we've iterated Reducto's product to handle anything.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Now, getting AI to work on a clean PDF with a frontier model is not that hard, but the truth is that most of enterprise documents are unstructured.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: That means, like, scanned documents, rotated documents, charts, and that's when things get really complex.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Reducto is the layer that sits right before your model.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: We handle complex layouts, but also as well as post-processing, so you can focus on building your actual product.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: The reason this works is that we take a rasterization-based approach.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: That means we look at your document like a human would look at the document instead of the underlying embedding.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

text: Everything is powered by our agentic OCR framework where rather than making a single pass and committing to an answer, the model flags things that it's uncertain about, corrects them, and then moves on to the next step.
speaker: SPEAKER_00

speaker: SPEAKER_00
